stats: Flames of Chayula are Remnants that grant the following bonuses when collected:
Red Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Life to you
Blue Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Mana to you
Purple Flames of Chayula provide a stacking Buff granting 7% of damage as extra Chaos damage for 8 seconds, and stacks up to 10 times.
